data.name: Sample - Cofense Triage - 2.0.0
data.description: Sample playbooks for "Cofense Triage" connector. If you are planning to use any of the sample playbooks in your environment, ensure that you clone those playbooks and move them to a different collection, since the sample playbook collection gets deleted during connector upgrade and delete.

workflows.name: Get Cluster Details
workflows.description: Fetches a single cluster that matches the specified cluster ID.

workflows.name: Get Report Details
workflows.description: Fetches a single report that matches the specified report ID.

workflows.name: Get Reports
workflows.description: Fetches reports in the Inbox, Recon, and Processed folders that match specified parameters. If no parameters are specified, fetches all reports.

workflows.name: Get Clusters
workflows.description: Fetches clusters that match specified parameters. If no parameters are specified, fetches all clusters.

workflows.name: Get Inbox Reports
workflows.description: Fetches uncategorized reports in the Inbox and Recon folders that match specified parameters. If no parameters are specified, fetches all reports in the Inbox and Recon folders.

workflows.name: Get Attachment Details
workflows.description: Downloads a single attachment that matches the specified attachment ID.

workflows.name: Download Attachment
workflows.description: Download an attachment from the Cofense Triage server based on the attachment ID you have specified.

workflows.name: Get Triage Threat Indicators
workflows.description: Fetches the URLs, domains, senders, subjects, or MD5 or SHA256 hashes that operators identified in Cofense Triage as threat indicators within a specified timeframe. If no parameters are specified, fetches all identified threat indicators.

arguments.title: Cofense Triage: Get Triage Threat Indicators

workflows.name: Get Hostname Details
workflows.description: Retrieves the details of a specific hostname from Cofense Triage based on the domain ID you have specified.

workflows.name: Get URL Details
workflows.description: Retrieves a URL details from Cofense Triage based on the endpoint and request you have specified.

workflows.name: Get Domain Details
workflows.description: Retrieves the details of a specific domain from Cofense Triage based on the domain ID you have specified.

workflows.name: Download Report
workflows.description: Retrieves files associated with a specific report from the Cofense Triage server based on the report ID you have specified.

workflows.name: Get Report Reporters Details
workflows.description: Fetches the IDs of all reporters and the number of reports those individuals reported over a specified timeframe.

arguments.title: Cofense Triage: Get Report Reporters Details
